main.description: Register (or refresh) an FCM push-notification token for the authenticated account. The `did` must equal the service-auth issuer DID; the token is stored in the shared notification-token store. XRPC form of the legacy Node `/saveNotificationToken` endpoint.

did.description: The account the token belongs to. Must equal the authenticated (service-auth issuer) DID.

token.description: The FCM registration token for this device.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: Missing did/token, or the FCM token failed validation.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The service-auth DID does not match the `did` being registered.
